'''Brinton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during [[3642 BBY]], he worked as a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] vendor and sold drinks inside [[Aurek Base]] Command Bunker.
